premise: A Ninho de Vespa-de-Vidro blocks the Passagem das Estacas. Signs suggest that its disturbance may have been deliberate, but the evidence is incomplete.

phases.objective: Accept conditional shelter and receive the route briefing.
phases.speaker: VARGA-NPC-001

phases.objective: Inspect route markers, nest disturbance and traveler testimony.
phases.speaker: VARGA-NPC-002

phases.objective: Choose a local response with documented cost.
phases.speaker: VARGA-NPC-003

phases.objective: Return to the Marco de Retorno and submit a factual report.
phases.speaker: VARGA-NPC-002

resolutions.title: Desvio Luminal
resolutions.effect: Travelers use the alternate path; the nest remains undisturbed and evidence stays incomplete.
resolutions.local_consequence: Safety rises for the immediate group while route pressure remains.

resolutions.title: Contenção do Barranco
resolutions.effect: The kit creates a controlled passage without harvesting or destroying the nest.
resolutions.local_consequence: The route reopens conditionally and the evidence record improves.

resolutions.title: Abertura Defensiva
resolutions.effect: The player creates an escape window during defensive swarm pressure; no fauna kill or loot is required.
resolutions.local_consequence: The passage opens briefly, but medical risk and suspicion increase.

evidence_rule: Evidence may support a local report and contextual reputation only. It cannot identify a culprit as canonical truth without an authorial gate.
rewards: runtime-only contextual reputation, temporary access and practical progression; no canonical item, title, territory or fact.
